findings.current: There was a simple reason Sama Pyo wore a thin robe instead of a lighter martial uniform in this heat: its full sleeves gave him room to hide weapons.
findings.defect: The source contrasts the thin robe with a simple, plain martial uniform (단출한 무복), not a lighter one. “Lighter” changes the clothing detail and conflicts with the source’s point that he wore the robe despite the heat.
findings.rationale: 단출한 describes the martial uniform as simple or plain; it does not describe its weight.
findings.replacement: There was a simple reason Sama Pyo wore a thin robe instead of plain martial clothes despite the heat: its full sleeves gave him room to hide weapons.

findings.current: Twist his wrist to the right angle, and the mechanism fired a loaded arrow.
findings.defect: “The right angle” can specify a 90-degree angle. The Korean says the arrow fires when he twists his wrist to a predetermined angle; it gives no degree measurement.
findings.rationale: 정해진 각도 means a predetermined angle, not necessarily a right angle.
findings.replacement: Twist his wrist to the set angle, and the mechanism fired a loaded arrow.

findings.current: He clicked his tongue and let his Black Dragon Saber hang at his side.
findings.defect: The assembled version omits that the Black Dragon Saber is Sama Pyo’s 독문병기—his own distinctive weapon.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly identifies the saber as his 독문병기, a detail preserved in the accepted baseline.
findings.replacement: He clicked his tongue and let his own Black Dragon Saber hang at his side.

summary: The translation is broadly faithful, but it alters a specific detail of the hidden-weapon mechanism and omits or blurs a few source details.
